notes.title: Design Workshop Preview + Release Date announcement
notes.notes:
Greetings, shoppers! 

Today we're releasing a patch for Clothing Store Simulator: Prologue (as seen on the main page of Steam)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/c9b8991852f41e8e241e9cc0da213f4a1283c07f.png

Major Changes

We've received a great response to the 'Design Your Own Clothes' feature coming in the full version of Clothing Store SImulator, so as a thank you, we've added a preview of the Design Workshop to the Prologue! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/e2f9029165e8395ab3037d535fd462e8c1d95692.png

In the Prologue, you can make 1 piece of clothing with your own design, so let your imagination fly! 

Other Changes & Fixes


 You can now interact with the 'Open/Close' sign from inside the Store;
 Fixed an issue where clothes were displayed incorrectly on the mannequins after being purchased.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/05c3f14ada708dc1af066cce1d191b6c96597702.png

And now for something completely different! We're ready to announce the release date of Clothing Store Simulator: Early Access! 

The full game will be available on June 17th! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/4198d8bdc6d09b905f81ecfa21951c060aeb6f79.png

Wishlist now: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923390/Clothing_Store_Simulator/
